ABOARD.description: Swap window: where a crew member is now

ABOARD_SHIP.description: Crew lounge: heading over the crew aboard

ACTIVE.description: Bay table: the row for the ship the player is flying

ADD_BAY.description: Button: lease one more bay in this hangar

ALL_THAT_FITS.description: Button in the swap window: take as much cargo as fits

ALREADY_ABOARD.description: Cargo already on the stored ship

ALREADY_LEASED.message: You already lease a hangar here.

A_MISSION.description: Fallback name for whatever holds some cargo

BAYS.description: Label: number of bays in a hangar

BAYS_CAN_CHANGE.message: Bays can be added or removed later.

BOUGHT_AND_STORED.message: "{ship}" is stored in your hangar here.

BOUGHT_HULL_SOLD.message: The hull of "{ship}" is sold: {items} item(s) went to the equipment store, {tons} t of cargo to the cargo store and {crew} crew to the lounge.

BRING_ABOARD.description: Tooltip: button bringing a crew member aboard

BUY_DESC_HULL.message: Its equipment goes to the hangar's equipment store and its cargo to the hangar's cargo store; only the hull is sold.

BUY_DESC_STORE.message: Kept as it is, with its equipment and all its cargo; nothing moves to the new ship. You pay the full price.

BUY_DESC_TRADEIN.message: Sold with all its equipment. All its cargo moves to the new ship.

BUY_MODE_HULL.message: Trade in the bare hull of "{ship}"

BUY_MODE_TRADEIN.description: Ship Market purchase window: a choice for the current ship

CANT_LAUNCH_FEWER.message: You can't launch with fewer than {min} crew.

CARGO_HOLD.description: Size of the ship's cargo hold

CARGO_RACK_IN_USE.message: the cargo it holds wouldn't fit without it

CARGO_STORE_HELP.message: Unload goods into the hangar's cargo store and load them into the ship you're flying. Unlimited and free; mission cargo keeps its mark.

COL_BAY_FEE.description: Bay table column: the fee for the bay itself

COL_PARKING.description: Bay table column: the fee per tonne of the ship parked

COL_PER_MONTH.description: Bay table column: bay fee plus parking fee

CREDIT_LINE.message: Paid upfront: {credit} of credit left, shared by all bays. At today's rent it lasts until about {date}; after that, rent is taken from your account on the 1st of each month.

CREW_SECTION.description: Purchase window: heading over the crew picker

CREW_STAY_HINT.message: Whoever isn't ticked waits in the lounge here.

CURRENT_SHIP_CHOICE.description: Purchase window: heading over the choices

DISMISS_OWED.message: You owe them {owed} in wages. They won't take it well, and owing more than {limit} counts as contract fraud.

DISMISS_TEXT.message: {name} is waiting in the lounge here. Their contract ends and they leave your crew.

DISMISS_TITLE.description: Window asking before someone in a lounge is dismissed

DRIVE_FUEL.description: Hyperdrive in the store: fuel it holds

END_LEASE.description: Button: end the lease of this hangar

END_LEASE_NEEDS_EMPTY.description: Tooltip on a disabled End lease button
END_LEASE_NEEDS_EMPTY.message: Only an empty hangar with no unpaid rent can be given up.

FITTED_ON.description: Equipment sub-tab: before the ship picker

FLY_THIS_SHIP.description: Button: swap to this stored ship

FROM_ACCOUNT.description: Where the next bill is paid from

FROM_CREDIT.description: Where the next bill is paid from

FROM_CREDIT_AND_ACCOUNT.description: Where the next bill is paid from
FROM_CREDIT_AND_ACCOUNT.message: Paid from your credit, the rest from your account.

GO_TO_HANGAR.description: Ship Market button opening the Hangar tab

HANGAR_LOCKED.message: This hangar is locked until the unpaid rent is paid.

HIRED_INTO_LOUNGE.message: Thanks! I'll wait in the crew lounge here until you need me aboard.

HULL_ALL_CREW_LOUNGE.message: All crew but you wait in the lounge here. Bring them aboard from the Hangar tab, Crew lounge.

IN_LOUNGE.description: Swap window: where a crew member is now

IN_LOUNGE_HERE.description: Crew lounge: heading over the crew waiting

ITEMS_IN_STORE.description: Equipment that couldn't be refitted is kept in the hangar
ITEMS_IN_STORE.message: {count} equipment item(s) are kept in this hangar's store.

ITEMS_MOVED_TO_STORE.message: {count} equipment item(s) didn't fit back on the ship and are kept in the hangar's store.

LIGHT_YEARS_AWAY.description: Crew tab: distance to a lounge in another system

LOUNGE_AFTER_SWAP.message: In the lounge here after the swap: {count}, {cost} a night, plus half wages.

LOUNGE_DEBT_BLOCKS.description: Why nobody can be put in a lounge
LOUNGE_DEBT_BLOCKS.message: You owe {debt} in lounge fees. Pay them before anyone else waits in a lounge.

LOUNGE_RATE_LINE.message: Lounge: {rate} per person per night ({now} a night now), billed on the 1st. Crew waiting here are paid half wages as a retainer and learn nothing new.

LOUNGE_UNPAID.message: Lounge fees couldn't be paid in full. You owe {debt}; it's taken from your money when you have it.

LOUNGE_WAGE_NOTE.message: Paid half wages while they wait. Move them in a station's Hangar tab, Crew lounge.

LOW_HULL_FUEL.message: "{ship}" is at {hull}% hull and {fuel}% fuel. Repairs and refuelling are available here.

MAX_BAYS_REACHED.message: A hangar has at most 4 bays.

MISSION_CARGO_STAYS.description: Swap window, when some mission cargo stays on the stored ship
MISSION_CARGO_STAYS.message: Mission cargo left behind has to be delivered with the ship that carries it.

NEEDS_CARGO_LIFE_SUPPORT.description: Swap window: this cargo can't go on the stored ship

NEEDS_LIFE_SUPPORT.message: {commodity} needs cargo life support, which the stored ship doesn't have.

NEXT_BILL_FULL.description: Under the bay table: a bill for a whole month. {to} is the last day it covers
NEXT_BILL_FULL.message: Next bill {date}: about {amount}, the rent for {from} – {to}. {source}

NEXT_BILL_PART.description: Under the bay table: the first bill, for part of a month. {to} is the last day it covers
NEXT_BILL_PART.message: Next bill {date}: about {amount}, the rent for {from} – {to} (part of a month). {source}

NOT_ABOARD.description: Swap blocker: the player is out of the ship
NOT_ABOARD.message: You need to be aboard your ship.

NOT_DOCKED_HERE.message: That ship is stored at another station.

NOT_PREPAID.description: Bay table, Paid until column, when nothing is paid upfront

NO_CREDIT_LINE.message: Nothing paid upfront: rent is taken from your account on the 1st of each month.

NO_EQUIP_VOLUME.description: Why an item can't be fitted

NO_HYPERDRIVE.message: none, it can't leave its system

NO_SHIPS_STORED.message: No ships are stored here yet.

NO_SLOT_FOR_IT.message: no slot for it on this ship

OFFER_POSITION_IN_LOUNGE.message: Make an offer of a position, waiting in the crew lounge here for now

OTHER_HANGAR.description: One of the player's other hangars

PARKING_CELL.description: Bay table: parking fee for the ship's hull mass

PASSENGERS_ABOARD.message: Passengers aboard: finish your passenger contracts first.

PAY_NOTHING_NOW.message: Nothing now: rent is billed on the 1st of each month.

PAY_UPFRONT.description: Label for the number of months or years to pay upfront

PAY_UPFRONT_BUTTON.description: Button: show the upfront payment controls

REMOVE_BAY_NEEDS_EMPTY.message: Only an empty bay can be removed, and a hangar keeps at least one.

RENT_EXAMPLE.message: Empty: {empty} per month. With "{ship}" ({tonnes} t) parked: {rent} per month.

RENT_RULE.message: Rent per month: {bay} per bay, plus {tonne} per tonne of hull parked.

RENT_UNPAID.description: Comms message when a monthly bill can't be paid
RENT_UNPAID.message: Rent for your hangar at {station} couldn't be paid. You owe {debt}; ships there are locked until it's paid.

RENT_UNPAID_BANNER.message: Rent unpaid: {debt} ({months} month(s), with a 10% late charge). Ships here are locked until it's paid.

ROVER_IS_OUT.message: the rover is parked out on a planet

ROVER_OUT.message: Your rover is parked on {planet}. Stow it first.

SELECT_A_SHIP.message: Select a stored ship in the table above to see it and fly it.

SELL.description: Button: sell an item from the hangar store

SELL_TEXT.message: {station} pays {price} for the {item}, as the Equipment Market would.

SELL_TITLE.description: Window asking before an item from the store is sold

SEND_TO_LOUNGE.description: Tooltip: button sending a crew member to the lounge

SHIP_ACTIVE_OPTION.description: Ship picker entry for the ship being flown

SHIP_FULL.description: Tooltip on a disabled bring-aboard button

SHIP_STORED_OPTION.description: Ship picker entry for a stored ship

SHOW_ON_MAP.description: Tooltip: button selecting a system on the sector map

SLOTS_TAKEN.message: its slots on this ship are taken

SLOT_WRONG_SIZE.message: its slot on this ship is the wrong size

STORE_HELP.message: Unfit items into the store, then fit them to the ship picked on the left, or sell them to this station. Equipment Market rules and prices, no fee for fitting. Pick an empty slot first to fit an item into that slot.

STORE_NEEDS_BAY.message: your hangar here has no free bay.

SWAP_NOTE.message: "{ship}" will be stored in this bay. Crew never stays on a stored ship: whoever isn't ticked below waits in the lounge here.

TAKE_FORMAT.description: Slider format for tonnes taken along

THEN_MONTHLY.message: After that, {rent} for each whole month, billed on the 1st.

THIS_IS_YOUR_SHIP.message: This is the ship you're flying.

TOO_FEW_CREW.message: "{ship}" needs at least {min} crew; {crew} are ticked. You can't launch until you hire more or take someone from the lounge.

TOO_MANY_CREW.message: "{ship}" takes at most {max} crew; {crew} are ticked. Untick {over} to leave them in the lounge.

TOO_MUCH_CARGO.message: "{ship}" has room for {room} t. Take {over} t less.

TRADE_IN_CARGO.description: Ship Market: trading in, and the cargo doesn't fit the new ship
TRADE_IN_CARGO.message: A {ship} holds {room} t, and you have {used} t aboard. When trading in, all cargo moves to the new ship: sell or unload {over} t first, or choose another option.

TRADE_IN_CARGO_SHORT.description: Purchase window: on the trade-in card
TRADE_IN_CARGO_SHORT.message: You have {used} t of cargo and a {ship} holds {room} t.

UNFIT_ALL_TOOLTIP.message: Move everything that can come off this ship into the store

UNFIT_CHILDREN_FIRST.description: Why an item can't be unfitted
UNFIT_CHILDREN_FIRST.message: unfit the items mounted on it first

WAITING_AT.description: Count of crew waiting at another station

WITHOUT_A_SLOT.description: Heading over items fitted without a slot

YOU_RECEIVE.description: When the trade-in is worth more than the new ship
